daily.topThemeBody: The EdTech Quality Collaborative — 1EdTech, CAST, CoSN, Digital Promise, ISTE and SETDA — published five quality pillars (safe, evidence-based, inclusive, usable, interoperable) with assessment templates. The target is tech sprawl: ~3,000 products per district per year, most barely used.
